name: Griste Vihkiruusu
description: The Griste Vihkiruusu cotton shirt is made of organic cotton and features the Vihkiruusu pattern. The straight-cut shirt has a relaxed fit and curved slits at the side seams.
We cut the shirts from the full width of the fabric, so the look of each shirt and the placement of the pattern vary. Every piece is unique.

Vihkiruusu was born at a time when flowers had little place in Marimekko's world of patterns. Maija Isola was drawn to floral motifs anyway, and set out to design a whole series of bold new floral prints. Alongside Vihkiruusu, the series also included Unikko.
